posts.author: Vincente4691
posts.body:
Recently bought the steam version of RPG Maker MV. Launching from steam or the EXE gives the same result; splash screen appears for a second or two, then process ends.
I'm aware that this is a reasonably common issue. I have looked at just about every thread I could find on this and tried as many solutions as I could, and no dice.
Worth noting that I have RPG Maker VX Ace installed on this system and it works fine. Also worth noting that this doesn't appear to be an issue with steam, as trying to run the MV demo from the RPG Maker site yields the same result.
System Information:
- Windows 10
- Boot drive SATA SSD
- RPG Maker installed to separate HDD under D:/steam/steamapps/common
- not sure if hardware specs are relevant but running an RX 6650XT, i5 9600K NOT OC'd, 64GB 2400mhz Ram
List of what I've tried, in order:
- Verifying integrity of files through steam
- Reinstalling the RPG Maker MV
- Deleting steam download cache, then reinstalling
- Reinstalling display drivers from manufacturer's website
- Disabling all antivirus including windows defender
- Unplugging second monitor, then rebooting PC
- Downgrading to version 1.5.1
- Opening somebody else's project manually through file explorer (since I've never created my own on this system).
- Installing on different drives (Boot SSD, E drive SSD)
Any help/suggestions are greatly appreciated.

posts.author: MiguelRPG
posts.body: I've seen this happen with programs that overlay, like discord or steam (shift+esc), disable steam and try to close discord.

posts.author: NoNameWithoutAName
posts.body:
I've had this issue when I needed to update Steam. I also encountered it more recently after getting a new laptop and disabling Steam on startup. I've realized that on this computer, if I don't let it run on startup, I have to manually launch Steam periodically (probably after restarting the device?) in order for RMMV to launch.
*The point being: try launching steam, letting it load up, closing it, and then launching RMMV
